verdict: Bio-Techne grew sales 5% to $300M on 9% growth at its core Protein Sciences business, but profit fell to $28M as costs tied to its pending takeover by Merck KGaA weighed on expenses.

kpis.label: Protein Sciences sales
kpis.note: +9% vs a year ago — about three-quarters of all sales

kpis.label: Cash from operations
kpis.note: vs $28M a year ago, on working-capital swings

segments.name: Protein Sciences
segments.note: Proteins, antibodies and assay reagents for research labs — sales rose about 9% to $219.7M, with a segment operating margin near 38%.

segments.name: Diagnostics and Spatial Biology
segments.note: Clinical diagnostic controls and spatial-biology tools that map tissue — sales were $80.2M, roughly flat vs $79.5M a year ago, and segment profit fell as costs rose.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Selling, general and administrative costs — up 15% to $133.7M, swollen by costs of the pending acquisition of Bio-Techne by Merck KGaA (about $18M of acquisition-related expenses sat in unallocated costs).

opex.name: R&D
opex.note: Research and development on new proteins, assays and diagnostic tools — up 9%.

takeaways.title: The core business carries growth
takeaways.text: Protein Sciences sales rose about 9% to $219.7M with a 37.9% segment operating margin, while Diagnostics and Spatial Biology was flat at $80.2M — all of the quarter's growth came from the core.

takeaways.title: Deal costs cut into profit
takeaways.text: Net earnings fell to $28.3M from $38.2M as SG&A jumped 15% — unallocated costs included about $17.8M of acquisition-related expenses for the pending Merck KGaA transaction, plus $3.8M of restructuring costs.

takeaways.title: Cash generation improved
takeaways.text: Cash from operations rose to $73.1M from $27.6M a year ago, and the cash balance grew to $350M even after paying a $12.6M dividend.

oneTimers: About $17.8M of acquisition-related expenses and other costs (pending acquisition by Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany) in unallocated corporate costs, plus $3.8M of restructuring and restructuring-related costs.
footerNote: Bio-Techne furnished no standalone earnings release this quarter — its November 4, 2026 Form 8-K only declared a dividend, against the backdrop of the pending Merck KGaA acquisition — so all figures are from the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, filed November 6, 2026. Bio-Techne reports in thousands ($299,712K of sales); figures are rounded to whole $M, with tax shown as $7M (actual $6.4M) so the rounded flow balances exactly. The second segment was renamed Diagnostics and Spatial Biology (formerly Diagnostics and Genomics). Segment sales are before a $0.1M intersegment elimination, which rounds to zero.
